universities.name: Imperial College London

programmes_english.name: Computing (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) MEng

universities.eligibility_cbse: General minimum for ISC/CBSE Class XII: 90% overall across five subjects, with 90% in relevant subjects. The Electrical Engineering department page is stricter: 95% Mathematics, 95% Physics, 95% overall, plus a rank on a common merit list based on JEE performance (may be waived). No foundation-year route verified. Confirm on the individual course page.

tests.jee: JEE Advanced acceptance not verified. The Electrical Engineering department page refers to a JEE-based merit-list rank (may be waived).
tests.other_exam: TMUA required for Computing courses (2027 entry); ESAT required for Electrical and Electronic Engineering (October or January sitting).
tests.interview: Computing: not standard, may be offered. EEE: decided after review of application and ESAT.
tests.ielts_min: Standard level 6.5 overall (6.0 each element); higher level 7.0 overall (6.5 each). The 2027 EEE booklet states the higher level; check each course.

universities.other_requirements: English test scores must be no more than two years old at course start.

application.closes: 23 September 2027, 18:00 UK (final UCAS date for 2027 entry)
application.deadlines_text: Equal consideration date 13 January 2027, 18:00 UK time. Applications received after 30 June 2027 go into Clearing.
application.application_fee: UCAS fee GBP 34.50 for 2027 entry, up to five choices

universities.other_fees: Year abroad is charged at 100% of that year's fee for overseas students (Mechanical Engineering and Computing International Programme pages).

living_cost.amount_text: Average range about GBP 1,821 to 1,893 per month (lower about 1,264, upper about 2,118), excluding tuition; international start-up costs up to GBP 1,500. Academic year of the estimate not verified.

scholarships.name: Imperial Inspires Scholarship (2027 entry)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 15,000 per year; at least 300 awards planned. Apply by 5 February 2027 after the 13 January UCAS deadline.
scholarships.who: International students paying the Overseas fee in eligible faculties

hostel.text: First-year undergraduates are guaranteed a bed space if Imperial is their firm choice, they are eligible and apply by the deadline (mid July 2027, date to be confirmed). 2026-27 hall rents about GBP 150 to 425 per week.

placement_employability.statistic: 86% of undergraduate respondents to the Graduate Outcomes Survey 2023 were in work or further study 15 months after graduating (another Imperial page cites 96% of all graduates, 2022/23 survey).

highlights: Overseas fee for 2027 entry GBP 47,800 per year on the engineering and Computing International Programme pages.
Imperial Inspires offers GBP 15,000 per year awards to overseas students.
challenges: High academic bar: 90% minimum, 95% on the Electrical Engineering page.
Extra admissions test (TMUA or ESAT) on top of board marks.
High cost: GBP 47,800 tuition plus London living costs.
universities.notes: imperial.ac.uk refused direct fetch (403), so all Imperial facts come from search-engine extracts of official pages; re-open them in a browser before publishing, including which exact page carries each figure (employability, alumni, rents, English level). No India country page verified. The GBP 47,800 fee was not shown for the standard Computing MEng G401 itself. One Imperial scholarship page says 2027 Inspires applications are not being accepted while others show the cycle open. NRI/fee-status rules not verified. lat/lon and climate_note are null: not verified from any official page.

universities.name: University of Edinburgh

programmes_english.name: Artificial Intelligence and Computer Science BSc

universities.eligibility_cbse: Only CBSE and CISCE Standard XII accepted. Science and Engineering: five Class XII subjects, overall average 80% or above and at least 80% in each required subject (85% where the programme asks for grade A at SQA Higher; Computer Science BEng asks for Higher Mathematics at A, so confirm whether 85% applies in Maths). CBSE Applied Mathematics does not count. Advanced entry to Year 2 (many programmes): 85% overall and in required subjects.

tests.toefl_min: 92 with 20 each (tests before 21 January 2026); 4.5 with 4.0 each (from 21 January 2026)

universities.other_requirements: Class XII English may satisfy the English requirement (a search extract cites 75%); confirm for the programme.

application.closes: 23 September 2027, 18:00 UK (final UCAS date for 2027 entry)
application.deadlines_text: Equal consideration date 13 January 2027, 18:00 UK time. Applications received after 30 June 2027 go into Clearing.
application.application_fee: UCAS fee GBP 34.50 for 2027 entry, up to five choices

universities.other_fees: International fee is fixed for the length of study based on start year. Student visa fee and immigration health surcharge are extra.

living_cost.amount_text: University estimate for 2026-27: GBP 1,546 per month; 13,914 for a 39-week year; 18,552 for a full year.

scholarships.name: Edinburgh Global Undergraduate Mathematics Scholarships
scholarships.value_text: GBP 5,000 (deadline listed as 31 March 2027; listing may be old)
scholarships.who: International/EU-fee students in the School of Mathematics only, not engineering or computer science

hostel.text: Guaranteed offer for new, single, full-year September-start undergraduates from outside Edinburgh who apply by 31 July and hold Unconditional Firm status by 31 August. Official weekly rent range not verified.

placement_employability.statistic: School of Informatics: 85% in work six months after graduating and 10% in further study (older six-month measure, year not stated). University-wide, class of 2018 (see https://blogs.ed.ac.uk/careersinformed/what-do-university-of-edinburgh-graduates-do/): 96.5% in work or further study at 15 months.

highlights: CBSE/ISC threshold for Science and Engineering starts at 80% overall.
First-year accommodation guarantee with a 31 July application deadline.
challenges: No India-specific undergraduate scholarship found for engineering or computer science.
State boards and CBSE Applied Mathematics are not accepted.
Exact 2027/28 overseas fee could not be retrieved.
universities.notes: 2027/28 fee null: the fee table did not render. The 2027 Undergraduate Guide gives only 2026 indicative levels (international from GBP 28,000; laboratory/studio degrees GBP 36,800) and says 2027 fees were then unconfirmed; do not quote these as the 2027 fee. Admissions test, interview, SAT and JEE: no requirement or acceptance found. NRI/fee-status rules not verified. lat/lon and climate_note are null: not verified from any official page.

universities.name: University of Manchester

programmes_english.name: BEng/MEng Electrical, Electronic and Mechatronic Engineering with Integrated Foundation Year (H112)

universities.eligibility_cbse: Computer Science (September 2027): CBSE/ISC average 90%, with 90% in Mathematics (not Applied Maths) and 85% in Physics or Computer Science (not Informatics Practices). University-wide direct entry is 80-95% depending on programme. Integrated foundation year (Science and Engineering): 70% overall, 75% in Maths and Physics, 65% in English. State boards have different thresholds.

tests.other_exam: BSc Computer Science: no admissions test required at present
tests.interview: Not mentioned on the Computer Science or EEE course pages
tests.ielts_min: Computer Science and Mechanical: 6.5 overall, no sub-score below 6.5. EEE MEng page: 7.0 overall, 7.0 writing, 6.5 other sub-scores.
tests.toefl_min: Computer Science: 90, 22 each. EEE: 100, 25 writing, 22 others (or 5 on the 1-6 scale, 5 writing, 4.5 others).

universities.other_requirements: The Computer Science department accepts 80% in CBSE/ISC Class XII English (not Functional English) as the English qualification; state board English is not accepted.

application.closes: 23 September 2027, 18:00 UK (final UCAS date for 2027 entry)
application.deadlines_text: Equal consideration date 13 January 2027, 18:00 UK time. Applications received after 30 June 2027 go into Clearing.
application.application_fee: UCAS fee GBP 34.50 for 2027 entry, up to five choices

tuition_non_eu.per: year (BSc Computer Science; may rise up to 7% each later year)

universities.other_fees: MEng Electrical and Electronic Engineering and MEng Mechanical Engineering: GBP 37,500 for 2027/28, may rise up to 7% each later year.

living_cost.amount_text: University estimate for a 41-week year: GBP 17,366 including self-catering accommodation 8,100, meals 2,500, transport 700, flights 1,750, general 3,120, visa health charge 776. Appears to be 2026/27; table is in student finance (US loans) guidance.

scholarships.name: Global Futures Scholarship 2027 (undergraduate)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 36,000 total (12,000 per year for three years) as a fee discount; apply by 30 March 2027; 60% in assessments to renew
scholarships.who: Domiciled in India, Bangladesh, Pakistan or Sri Lanka; direct first-year entry 2027; self-funded; Manchester as firm choice by 15 May 2027; excludes foundation-year courses, Medicine, Dentistry and Architecture

hostel.text: One offer of a hall room guaranteed to eligible new undergraduates who apply and firmly accept an unconditional place by 31 August (2027 dates to be updated in early 2027). 2025/26 rents from GBP 119 (shared facilities), 175 (en-suite) and 184 (catered) per week.

placement_employability.statistic: Computer Science: 87% of graduates in work or further study, median salary GBP 30,000 (Graduate Outcomes, as cited in 2026).

highlights: Global Futures Scholarship for India-domiciled students worth GBP 36,000.
Published India thresholds for Computer Science and a foundation-year route from 70%.
challenges: Computer Science needs 90% overall and 90% in Mathematics.
The GBP 39,700 Computer Science fee can rise up to 7% a year.
The scholarship covers three years only, so a fourth MEng year is not covered.
universities.notes: QS conflict: the Manchester profile and main listing extracts show =40, while other topuniversities extracts show 36; verify. Living cost, rents, employability and individual alumni attributions come from search extracts, so confirm the page. JEE and SAT not mentioned. NRI/fee-status rules not verified. lat/lon and climate_note are null: not verified from any official page.

universities.name: Trinity College Dublin

programmes_english.name: Engineering (common entry; includes Computer, Electronic, Mechanical, Civil, Biomedical)

universities.eligibility_cbse: CBSE and ISC Class XII accepted. 2027 non-EU admission guide: competitive average of Standard XII subject grades (A1=95, A2=85, B1=75, B2=65, C1=55, C2=45): Computer Science band 2 = 85; Engineering band 3 = 75. Mathematics requirement level 2 = 75% in Standard 12 for both. Six valid subjects (Year 10 or later subjects can make up the number), passes in English and Mathematics at Year 10 or later, and usually a language other than English. The India web page states 80-85% across six subjects. Meeting minimums does not guarantee a place. International Foundation Programme for those who do not qualify.

tests.sat: Not listed for Indian boards (SAT appears for the US curriculum)
tests.toefl_min: 90 with 21 each (before January 2026); 4.5 with 4.0 each (after January 2026)
tests.local_language_requirement: Irish not required for this route; a language other than English at Year 10 is usually needed (may not apply to those who need an English test)

universities.other_requirements: For 2027 admission, date of birth must be before 15 January 2011. Engineering programmes have a Fitness to Practice requirement.

application.opens: 1 November (portal opening date as stated by Trinity)
application.deadlines_text: 1 February priority date, with decisions aimed by 1 April; 30 June final. Non-EU students apply directly to Trinity.

tuition_non_eu.per: year (first-year total for Computer Science and for Engineering; may rise in later years)

universities.other_fees: Computer Science and Business: EUR 23,250 (2027/28). Optional Smart Start week EUR 660 plus accommodation.

living_cost.amount_text: EUR 19,937 to 29,050 per academic year (2027 international prospectus); the cost-of-living web page gives 19,937 to 28,300.

scholarships.name: Trinity India undergraduate scholarships
scholarships.value_text: EUR 3,000 to 5,000, first year only; batch deadlines 1 March, 2 May, 15 June (dates may relate to the 2026/27 cycle)
scholarships.who: Non-EU students schooled in India, e.g. 90% in Class XII; engineering and computer science eligibility must be confirmed

hostel.text: No guarantee found; first-year non-EU undergraduates are prioritised if they apply by the housing deadline (1 July for 2026/27). 2026/27: Trinity Hall from EUR 178 per week (about EUR 7,227 per academic year).

highlights: 2027/28 first-year non-EU fee EUR 30,450 for Computer Science and Engineering.
The Trinity guide cites up to two years' stay-back under the Third Level Graduate Programme and QS 63rd in the world for employment outcomes.
challenges: Dublin accommodation is costly and not guaranteed.
The general Global Excellence scholarship excludes engineering and computer science.
The six-subject and non-English language rules can affect CBSE/ISC applicants.
universities.notes: No graduate employment percentage verified. Engineering with Management and Computer Science and Business entry bands not recorded (check the guide matrix). Application dates and fee, scholarship, housing and cost figures come from search extracts; the admission guide PDF and the fee and India pages were read directly. EU/non-EU fee status rules for NRIs not verified. lat/lon and climate_note are null: not verified from any official page.

universities.name: University College Dublin

programmes_english.name: BE Engineering, common first year (NUS1): Biomedical, Chemical and Bioprocess, Civil, Electrical and Electronic, Mechanical, Structural with Architecture, Sustainable Systems

universities.eligibility_cbse: Class XII CBSE or CISCE (some state boards too), average of the best five recognised subjects, 2027 entry: Computer Science 80% average with Mathematics 80% in XII or 85% in X. Engineering 80% average, XII Mathematics 85% and a laboratory science 80%. The Engineering row also mentions an OMPT-D 55% test as a 2027/28 pilot; confirm whether it applies.

tests.other_exam: OMPT-D 55% mentioned for Engineering (pilot; applicability unconfirmed)
tests.local_language_requirement: English: 80% in CBSE/ISC Class XII English, or IELTS/TOEFL or equivalent. No local-language requirement found for the India route.

application.deadlines_text: Non-EU applicants apply directly to UCD (not through CAO) and are assessed on a rolling basis. General closing date for India not verified.
application.application_fee: EUR 70 on the general page; a US-applicant page says EUR 60

universities.other_fees: EUR 750 deposit for UCD Residences. Non-EU fee is generally held at the entry-year rate for the same programme.

living_cost.amount_text: Monthly (2026 figures): accommodation EUR 830 lowest, 1,200 median, 2,250 high; electricity, gas and bins 85 to 205; food 350 to 670; travel and books extra.

scholarships.name: UCD Global Excellence Scholarship 2027/28
scholarships.value_text: 100% or 50% of tuition; renewal needs Stage GPA 3.08/4.20; deadline likely 31 March 2027 for India (inferred, India not named in the regional lists)
scholarships.who: Incoming non-EU fee students holding a UCD offer; check eligible programmes and regions

hostel.text: First-year non-EU undergraduates are prioritised but on-campus housing is not guaranteed. A 2026/27 US-applicant page quotes EUR 7,000 to 12,000 per year depending on residence.

placement_employability.statistic: 93% of undergraduate degree graduates working or in further study 9 months after graduation (survey year not captured).

highlights: QS 2027 joint 100th, up 18 places; THE 2027 joint 212th.
80% best-five average for Computer Science and Engineering.
Full and half tuition Global Excellence Scholarships.
challenges: On-campus accommodation is not guaranteed and Dublin housing is costly.
Engineering needs 85% in Mathematics plus a laboratory science, with a possible extra maths test.
The 2027/28 fee and general closing date could not be verified.
